title: Five years. One story.
intro: Jabali Chorale turns five. This is the road so far and the road ahead — four chapters, two behind us and two to come, that tell how a few voices became a ministry in song.

chapters.heading: Where the song began
chapters.tale: A handful of voices, one conviction, and a season of giving that took the chorale out into the community for the very first time.

chapters.heading: Finding our voice
chapters.tale: Nightly worship, section by section, until the blend became unmistakable. This was the week Jabali learned to sound like one body.

chapters.heading: The night ahead
chapters.tale: The chorale steps into its fullest season yet — a praise night to open the second half of the year and carry the story forward.

chapters.heading: The homecoming
chapters.tale: Five years, gathered into one programme. A cantata on the Second Coming to close the journey where it always pointed — to Christ.
